list.title: Categories
list.subtitle: Group your income and expenses under names that make sense to you. Predefined categories are shared by everyone and cannot be changed.

empty.allBody: Create the first one to start sorting your transactions.
empty.personalTitle: You have no categories of your own yet
empty.personalBody: The predefined ones cover the basics. Create your own when you need something more specific.
empty.globalBody: Predefined categories will show up here once there are any.

delete.question: Delete “{{name}}”? It will no longer show up in your lists.

form.createSubtitle: Give it a short name and a description that reminds you which transactions belong here.
form.editSubtitle: Changes apply to every transaction that uses this category.
form.descriptionPlaceholder: Food, vet visits and supplies for the house
form.readOnly: This is a predefined category: you can use it, but you cannot edit or delete it.

tips.label: Tips
tips.title: Before you save
tips.short: A short name reads better in reports and lists.
tips.unique: The name cannot repeat another category, including a predefined one.
tips.private: Only you can see your personal categories.
